notes: Real-world Linux ARM64 ELF built in colima/Debian-bookworm container. Dropbear 2016.74 (Mar 2016) predates CVE-2016-3116 patch. CVE chain: x11req receives attacker-controlled cookie via SSH packet (buf_getstring), stores in chansess struct. x11accept callback (deferred until first X11 connection) invokes x11setauth, which calls popen('/usr/bin/xauth -q', 'w') then `fprintf(pipe, "add %s %s %s\n", ...attacker_cookie...)`. xauth shell parses that input — cookie containing `;` or `\n` injects shell commands.

cves.source: buf_getstring (deferred via chansess struct from x11req)
cves.notes: Real sink shape: popen() args are Const, but fprintf(popen_FILE*, fmt, %s_args) writes attacker-controlled bytes into the xauth shell's stdin. Below current static SAT ceiling because: (1) requires cross-statement tracking of popen's FILE* return through subsequent fprintf calls, (2) needs a new SinkKind for `fprintf/fputs/fputc to popen-output FILE*`, and (3) the source flows via deferred callback (x11req → chansess struct field → x11accept → x11setauth) which the inter-proc summary lift doesn't follow. Documented FN; expected NOT to surface as Reachable. Calibration TN if no candidate fires; FP if pipeline produces a spurious Reachable. v22+ work: extend DEFAULT_SINKS with FilePipe-write sink kind.
